GOOD QUESTIONS

A little clarity
goes a long way.

Can I target consumer markets by income or territory?

Yes, at the area level. Consumer profiles can compare counties, cities, census tracts or ZIP Code Tabulation Areas using published Census / ACS estimates such as median household income. ZCTAs are statistical areas, not exact postal ZIP boundaries. These profiles include no consumer names, personal contacts or individual income. They support market planning rather than personal outreach. Explore consumer-market profiles ↗

Can I buy and download a list today?

Not yet. This is the pre-launch collection catalog. You can explore packages, download illustrative samples and export a project brief. Checkout and actual datasets will be added after fulfillment is ready.

Are these opted-in leads or booked appointments?

No. The proposed products are business research and aggregate market profiles, not opt-in marketing subscribers, expressions of buying intent or appointments. A listed business has not necessarily agreed to be contacted. Buyers must assess their own outreach permissions and obligations.

Will every record contain a direct email?

No. Availability varies by industry and source. Missing or unconfirmed information should remain labeled—not guessed. Field coverage and any email-verification method will be agreed before a paid order.

Where will the information come from?

The intended research approach uses business websites, permitted public sources and appropriately licensed data. Source availability and reuse rights must be checked for each project. Consumer-market profiles use published aggregate Census / ACS statistics. Restricted accounts and private consumer data are outside the intended scope.

Are the lists exclusive?

The proposed standard packages are non-exclusive. Any exclusive territory or custom research rights would need a separate written agreement.

Can this connect to my CRM?

The initial delivery format is CSV, suitable for mapping into most CRM import tools. Direct integrations, a searchable database and ongoing refresh plans can be added later; they are not included in this launch catalog.
